text:
maria: Quick PSA — noticed p95 token decode latency up ~18% since last canary. Traces point to host-side parse + streaming chunking overhead, not GPU. Anyone looking?

carl: :eyes: I started profiling the ingress proxy. perf top shows a lot of time in writev and grpc_http2_frame_writer::write_frame. Running a couple of traces now.

carl: ```sudo perf record -F 99 -g -p $(pgrep ingress-proxy) && sudo perf script | flamegraph.pl > /tmp/ingress-flame.svg```
Sample snippet from the flame: writev -> grpc_frame_writer::write_frame -> http2::encode_data -> rust_shim::socket_send

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: canary deploy 2026-03-19T22:10 UTC finished on cluster-hosted-gpu-2 (rev 2026.03.19.8).

sophie: Checked kvcache metrics — hitrate steady, eviction rates normal. So kvcache seems NOT the culprit. Batch size distribution also unchanged.

carl: Seeing lots of tiny writes (~200-800B) per generated token when streaming chunking is on. Syscall count per request up ~3x. Suspect missing MSG_MORE / coalescing in the Rust shim write path.

jen: Reproduced locally with wrk -t8 -c200 against the shim. Swapping to a simple coalescing buffer (flush at 8KB or on EOF) yields p95 improvement ~22% in the bench.

infra-bot: note: some hosts still on kernel 5.15; TCP cork behaviour differs vs 6.x. Could amplify small-write penalty on older kernels.

maria: OK — plan: small, guarded canary. Add coalesce-on-stream-path behind feature flag + metrics for small_write_count and avg_write_size. Keep default off for now. I'll open a PR and add rollout steps.

carl: I'll prototype in rust-shim: buffer small proto frames into a Vec<u8>, use send(fd, buf, MSG_MORE) when available, fallback to writev if MSG_MORE not present. Will run perf before/after.

jen: I'll wire integration loadbench and run an A/B canary in us-west-2. Also test across kernels (5.15/6.2) to catch cork differences.

maria: :thumbsup: TODOs: 1) PR with flag `stream_coalesce_bytes` default 0; 2) perf harness results attached; 3) unit test for flush-on-eof; 4) rollout doc with canary and quick rollback.

carl: :hourglass: Perf run uploaded: https://redwood.internal/bench/173210-perf-coalesce-1 — bench numbers: hosted streaming p95 down from 240ms -> 185ms, syscall count/request down ~2.6x. Will paste raw CSV in the PR.
